prompt: A geostationary object, two consecutive fits. Name the event, and the first action the governing procedure requires.
plot_description: Sub-satellite longitude against time. Two fits sit almost on top of each other in epoch, and the line drawn between them implies a longitude rate orders of magnitude beyond anything a geostationary platform can produce.
expert_cue: No platform produces that rate. When the implied physics is impossible, the fit is the hypothesis on trial, not the orbit. Check epoch spacing before anything else.
